src.gen: A dim 2010-era apartment kitchen at night, an old laptop glowing on a cluttered table showing a plain cryptocurrency wallet screen with a number on it, a flip phone beside it
src.move: the laptop screen glows and flickers, a hand reaches toward the keyboard

src.gen: A plain cardboard pizza box sitting on a kitchen counter at night, steam still rising from under the lid, a crumpled receipt beside it, warm takeout lighting
src.move: a hand lifts the pizza box lid, steam rises into the light

src.gen: Close view of an old laptop screen on a kitchen table at night, a simple wallet balance number glowing in green pixel font, a pizza box slightly out of focus behind it
src.move: the green number on the screen pulses once, steady and glowing

src.gen: A close view of a laptop screen at night showing a plain rising green line chart climbing across the screen, reflected light on a dark kitchen table
src.move: the green line on the chart climbs steadily up and to the right

src.gen: A plain bank statement page lying under a desk lamp on dark wood, a single large printed number on the page, a pen resting beside it, nobody's face visible
src.move: a hand slides the paper further into the lamp's light

src.gen: A dim room at night with a single leather armchair facing a wide window, city lights far below, a man in a dark suit seen only from behind standing at the glass
src.move: the man at the window slowly turns his head toward the light
